reuse.why: The change reuses category selection, amount conversion, batching, and undo wrappers, but implements tag recognition instead of using extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Budget eligibility remains centralized, but the inline #fixed regex duplicates tag-recognition logic already provided by shared/tags.ts.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculation stay in actions.ts, while method registration and mutation wrappers remain in app.ts.

scope.why: All edits address the requested bulk-budget exclusions, new spending action, optional hidden-category inclusion, or their tests.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility function keeps policy changes localized, although bespoke tag matching creates another definition maintainers must keep consistent.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories in actions.ts recognizes #fixed with an inline regex rather than shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: The specialized #fixed regex reshapes the existing shared tag-recognition logic into a local membership test.

abstraction_drift.where: The bulk-category helper renames its existing hidden-category option and extends its existing exclusion branch; every month-wide action, including the new consumer, continues to use it.
